description: Outside MCP servers the Agentforce agents may call, registered in Agentforce Registry (Setup) with No Authentication, so nobody signs in. Salesforce does not deploy or package a registration, so this file is the record of what each org registers by hand: docs/INSTALL.md step 11b has the clicks, docs/GUARDRAILS-AND-MCP.md the design. scripts/lib/mcp-probe.js checks every server here still answers and still offers every allowlisted tool; test/config/esp32-mcp.test.js checks the agents and docs agree with it. To add a server: add an entry, allowlist only read-only tools, name the agents that may use it. ESP-VISION was dropped on Nov 19 (camera and AI only, not needed here). Espressif's documentation server (https://mcp.espressif.com/docs) is deliberately not here: it needs each user's GitHub sign-in (docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).
